text:
Priya (Partnerships): Hey team — onboarding Cloudnix SI for the Marketplace launch next week. We need a concise SEV handoff path (shared channels, war room process, who gets paged). Can we standardize so PMs/CS know what to expect?

Oscar (Support): +1. My proposal: two channels per partner — #partner-cloudnix-support for day-to-day async + #partner-cloudnix-sev (private) for active SEVs/warrooms. Marketplace team to create shared channel and invite vendor account.

Alex (Eng SRE): From SRE side: please ensure #partner-cloudnix-sev has the following pre-configured before launch: add @sre-oncall alias, @support-pager alias, set message retention 90d, enable pinned runbook, and enable the PD integration. When a P0 happens move the discussion to the SEV channel and start a war room bridge.

Samantha (Solutions): I'll own the runbook content. I'll add a short checklist at the top of the runbook: impact statement, primary contact, mitigation steps, rollback plan, data sensitivity notes, and a postmortem owner. Link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/partners/cloudnix-sev (WIP).

Liam (PartnerEng): A few operational bits: 1) Pager mapping: P0 -> vendor pager + redwood SRE + support triage, P1 -> vendor business hours + support triage. 2) Use the tag [PARTNER:CLOUDNIX] on all SEV messages so we can filter. 3) Warroom creation shortcut: `/warroom open partner cloudnix` (Marketplace bot will create channel + bridge).

vendor-liaison (Cloudnix): Thanks — we'll add a 24/7 escalation pager for P0s and nominate a primary and backup. We'll also join the shared channel and subscribe to the PD integration. Confirming phone: +1-555-0199 for oncall.

marketplace-bot: I can seed the channels. Command: `/shared-channel create partner-cloudnix-support --visibility public --invite vendor-liaison@cloudnix` and `/shared-channel create partner-cloudnix-sev --visibility private --invite vendor-liaison@cloudnix,sre-oncall`

Priya (Partnerships): Nice. Can we also agree on a short P0 message template so the first ping is actionable?

Oscar (Support): Yep — here's a template I use. Paste into the pinned message in #partner-cloudnix-sev:
```
[P0] [PARTNER:CLOUDNIX] Impact: (what's failing)
Scope: (users / regions / customers)
Observed: (metrics/alerts)
Mitigation so far: (short bullets)
Owner: (name + contact)
Next steps: (2-3 immediate actions)
Warroom bridge: (link)
```

Alex (Eng SRE): Also add these quick run commands to the pinned doc (for infra ops folks):
```
# check kafka backlog for partner queues
/k8s exec -n infra kafka-consumer -- tail -n 200 /var/log/consumer.log | grep CLOUDNIX
# restart gateway for partner region
/cmd restart gateway-cloudnix-eu --graceful
```

Samantha (Solutions): I'll populate the runbook with those commands and a decision tree: when to escalate to SRE, when to call vendor engineering, and when to cut traffic.

Liam (PartnerEng): Rotation: vendor provides 24/7 P0, Redwood provides SRE oncall + support triage in first 30 mins. After 30m, if unresolved, escalate to Eng leads + PartnerEng. We should capture SLAs in the partner integration doc.

vendor-liaison (Cloudnix): Confirmed on our end. We'll provide hourly status updates in the warroom until mitigated.

Priya (Partnerships): Great — Oscar can you create the shared channels and pin the template + runbook? Then we can mark this as the official SEV path for Cloudnix and copy pattern for future marketplace partners.

Oscar (Support): On it. Creating now. Will post links once done. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Created shared channel: #partner-cloudnix-support (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/SUPCLOUDNIX). Created private channel: #partner-cloudnix-sev (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/SEVCLOUDNIX). Invites sent.

Oscar (Support): Pinned the P0 template and runbook draft in #partner-cloudnix-sev. Added @sre-oncall and @support-pager aliases. Also set channel retention to 90 days and enabled PD integration.

Priya (Partnerships): Perfect — I'll notify the PMs and CS leads. Thanks everyone. Let's replicate this checklist for the next partner.

Liam (PartnerEng): Saving checklist as a template here: https://redwood.example.com/partners/onboarding/templates/sev-handoff-checklist.md

Priya (Partnerships): Closing out this thread — feels good to have a repeatable pattern. :rocket:
